tags: [travel, packing]
---

Bag: Osprey Farpoint 40, 1.5 kg empty. TAP allows 55x40x20 up to 8 kg; Ryanair free under-seat is 40x20x25 so the
Farpoint means paying for priority (€6 to €24). Last weigh-in at home: 7.6 kg for the [[Kyoto]] trip.

- [ ] passport, plus a scan emailed to myself
- [ ] 3 merino tees (Icebreaker 150), 1 long sleeve, 2 bottoms, 4 pairs of socks
- [ ] liquids pouch 20x20 cm, every bottle 100 ml max: toothpaste, SPF50, contact lens solution, mini shampoo bar
- [ ] Anker 10,000 mAh powerbank (has to stay with me, never in the hold)
- [ ] universal adaptor, plus a type A for Japan
- [ ] eye mask + Loop earplugs, see [[Jet lag strategy]]
- [ ] 2 packing cubes (grey = clean, orange = dirty)
- [ ] laptop + 65 W USB-C charger if it's a workation
- [ ] Kindle
- [ ] tiny vocab notebook + 2 pens
- [ ] foldable tote for groceries
- [ ] insurance policy PDF offline, picked via [[Travel insurance comparison]]

Rules I keep relearning: roll, don't fold. Wear the heaviest shoes on the plane. If it hasn't been worn on the last
two trips, it stays home.
